Discussed how festivals vary by region and may be celebrated differently.
Identified Diwali practices and regional differences in sweets and customs.
Practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready.
Named Onam in Kerala and Magh Bihu in Assam, including pookalam, bonfire and pitha.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised regional festival traditions with Kavya using examples and hints. Kavya correctly identified several regional connections and later linked harvest festivals to ready crops; the sowing-time and summer mix-ups were corrected during the discussion. At home, ask Kavya to sort three festivals into region, season, and one tradition.
